description: This file defines a NotesRepository class that manages CRUD operations and storage for Note objects using Android's SharedPreferences. It provides methods to retrieve, add, update, and delete notes, handling JSON serialization with Gson.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing Note objects with CRUD operations and local storage integration using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes stored in SharedPreferences, deserializing from JSON.

methods.name: saveAllNotes
methods.description: Serializes and saves a list of notes into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to the beginning of the notes list and saves it.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID, refreshing its 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note by ID from the stored list.
